2608.30712.title: GUIDE: Guiding Internal Evidence with Language Instructions
2608.30712.paper_summary: Large multimodal models follow instructions about what to generate, but not necessarily about what evidence to rely on. Hence, models may continue to depend on shortcut-associated cues even when instructions suggest otherwise. We introduce GUIDE, a framework for controlling internal evidence usage through language instructions. GUIDE combines grouped parameter-efficient adaptation with instruction-conditioned gating to modulate multimodal evidence pathways during reasoning and generation. We further introduce a pathway-level evaluation framework that characterizes instruction-conditioned evidence modulation through reliance sensitivity, controlled perturbation analysis, pathway modulation, and autoregressive decoding dynamics. Across multimodal reasoning, classification, and generation, GUIDE induces structured and instruction-aligned redistribution of evidence reliance while largely preserving task behavior. Experiments on GQA, TextVQA, MM-IMDb, CREMA-D, RAVDESS, and Flickr30K show that GUIDE improves robustness under targeted evidence perturbations and enables controllable modulation across diverse multimodal settings. This suggests that multimodal instruction following can extend beyond output control toward regulating how different evidence sources contribute to model predictions.
2608.30712.paper_summary_zh: 大型多模態模型遵循生成內容的指示，但不一定遵循依賴於哪些證據的指示。因此，即使指示暗示了其他情況，模型仍可能繼續依賴於與捷徑相關的線索。我們介紹了 GUIDE，一個通過語言指示控制內部證據使用的框架。GUIDE 結合了分組的參數高效適應和基於指示的閘控，以調節推理和生成過程中的多模態證據通路。我們進一步介紹了一個通路級評估框架，該框架通過依賴敏感性、受控擾動分析、通路調節和自回歸解碼動態來表徵基於指示的證據調節。在多模態推理、分類和生成中，GUIDE 促進了證據依賴的結構化和與指示對齊的重新分配，同時在很大程度上保持了任務行為。在 GQA、TextVQA、MM-IMDb、CREMA-D、RAVDESS 和 Flickr30K 上的實驗顯示，GUIDE 在針對性證據擾動下提高了穩健性，並實現了在多樣的多模態設置中可控的調節。這表明，多模態指示遵循可以超越輸出控制，進而調節不同證據來源對模型預測的貢獻。
